answer: All 219 firehouses in the FDNY Firehouse Listing (data/raw/fire_ems/firehouses.json, downloaded with $limit=5000 so not truncated) have coordinates. 219 of 219 records have numeric latitude and longitude, all inside the NYC bounding box, and none are zero or blank. So 0 are missing coordinates, which matches the 'firehouses_without_coordinates' logic in pro/fire_ems.py (it counts rows whose lat/lon fail float conversion). Computed directly on the raw JSON on the Mac; no ArcPy run was needed.
traps_or_caveats: 219 is the number of listing records (facilities), not the number of fire companies: some records combine several units (e.g. 'Engine 4/Ladder 15', 'Manhattan Borough Command/Battalion 1/Engine 7/Ladder 1').
'Have coordinates' means non-null numeric lat/lon in the file, not that the coordinates are verified accurate; I only checked they fall within a NYC bounding box.
The count reflects the snapshot downloaded 2026-10-22; the live portal listing may change.
The firehouse source was fetched with $limit=5000, so the 219 is not a truncated page.
